jobs.title: Altum Media appoints Owen Richards as Non-Executive Director
jobs.description:
General News

Altum Media appoints Owen Richards as Non-Executive Director

Altum Media today announced a new partnership with Owen Richards, Founder of Air Marketing and Roots To Market, bringing him on board as Non-Executive Director.

By

Abby Millar

Altum Media today announced a new partnership with Owen Richards, Founder of Air Marketing and Roots To Market. The Exeter marketing agency welcomes Owen as a Non-Executive Director, and his wealth of experience will help to fast track the business’ ambitious growth plans.

‍

“We feel privileged to have Owen Richards join our leadership team,” says Abby, Co-Founder at Altum Media. “From our first coffee together it was clear that Owen understood us and shared similar values. He'll bring a wealth of experience and knowledge to our business and we're confident that together we will create a better, more sustainable company for our team and for our clients. We're excited for the next year ahead.”

‍

Owen will be mentoring Altum Media Founders Nathan Hoare and Abby Millar to help them reach the next stage in their business’ growth. By carving out a strong business structure, Owen will be equipping the driven agency owners with the knowledge, tools and data they need to make informed business decisions and form good habits as they grow.

“I absolutely love this stage of business so it’s really nice to be involved but not necessarily carry all the pressure on my shoulders for once,” says Owen, Founder of outsourced sales agency, Air Marketing. “It’s a great partnership and I’m excited.”

‍

About Altum Media

Altum Media is a creative digital marketing agency in Exeter dedicated to delivering impactful digital content to help their clients grow their community, brand equity, and revenue. Specialising in digital strategy, content marketing, email marketing and social media marketing, Altum Media currently work with Pipers Farm, Fish For Thought, Luscombe Drinks, Dartmoor Whisky, Dartmouth Steam Railway and RocketGro. After moving into their first office in May 2021 and building out a talented team, the young agency have been nominated as Finalists in both the ‘New Business’ and ‘Creative’ categories in this year’s Exeter Living Awards.

About Owen Richards

Owen Richards is the Founder and CEO of Air Marketing, a leading provider of B2B outsourced sales. Owen is a dynamic and driven individual, and this year his Exeter based company; Air Marketing, has grown by 100%. He believes the motivation and engagement of your team are vital in the success of your business so coaching and mentoring them is invaluable - something which he is looking forward to with his new role as part of the Altum Media leadership team.

Watch Altum Founders Abby & Nathan interview Owen about the new partnership

Categories

Internal Number:

Incumbent serves as a member of the department’s leadership team with broad responsibilities to managing a complex organization and is instrumental in aligning the department’s strategic direction with City goals. The position leads and coordinates assigned activities across department offices and divisions, other City departments, and external agencies, consultants, and vendors while establishing and maintaining effective relationships throughout the community. Requires advanced knowledge of open space and environmental stewardship standards, and strong leadership skills.

This is an at-will appointed position without tenure, exempt from the career service system.

Please attach a cover letter and resume to be considered for this position. Early application is encouraged, as this position will close on August 28, 2026.

This Position Is Eligible For Full City Benefits, Including

Health Insurance
Dental, Vision and Life Insurance
Paid vacation and personal leave
6-12 weeks of paid parental leave available
Retirement contributions toward a pension plan and/or 401(k)
A robust Employee Assistance Plan (EAP)
Up to $4,000 tuition reimbursement annually
Discounted supplemental benefits like pet insurance and legal services

Typical Duties

Drives ongoing department strategic planning activities. Works with and supports internal work teams and external partners to set and accomplish planning objectives. Works closely with division directors to align strategic planning with operating planning.
The incumbent develops and implements policies and procedures for assigned programs and the department that result in transparency and accountability. Sets service delivery benchmarks, performance metrics, and methodology to evaluate outcomes.
Designs, implements, and monitors assigned programs including management and oversight of best management practices, environmental stewardship, operating budgets, performance measures, personnel, equipment maintenance, etc. Recommends and initiates process improvements, cost-saving measures, efficiencies and other program changes necessary to enhance operations and meet program goals and objectives.
Participates in the development of the annual budget document. Monitors and manages department-related budget, resources, and financial transactions. Ensures appropriate processes, procedures, and policies are in place and followed for all financial transactions.
Analyzes and formulates department policies, goals, and objectives to improve efficiency and effectiveness. Creates strategic plans to support the policies, goals, and objectives of the programs within the department.
Resolves complex issues involving maintenance operation and environmental stewardship. Ensures that operations and maintenance of programs and resources comply with City, State, and Federal regulations to protect the environment and ensures safe work practices.
Presents the department’s policies and positions in meetings, negotiations, and communications with the public, community and industry groups, Mayor and City Council members, other government agencies, the media and other public forums within assigned areas of authority.
Ensures employee productivity and effective use of resources by coaching, mentoring, and training supervisory staff and building an effective team. Evaluates and documents performance of program managers and office staff, administers appropriate and employee rewards and disciplinary actions.
Plays a key roll in establishing disaster and emergency preparedness programs and ensures department’s safety and emergency programs are effectively implemented
Represents the department in public meetings and/or on various committees as directed.
Supports the City Parks, Natural Lands, Urban Forestry and Trails Advisory Board, and other public advisory boards as assigned.
Performs other duties as required.

Minimum Qualifications

Bachelor’s degree in Business Management, Landscape Architecture Biology, Public Administration, Parks and Recreation, Land Management or a related field; and eight (8) years progressively responsible work experience in public administration activities and/or related work, four (4) years of which must have been in a supervisory position. Six (6) years applicable management experience may be substituted for the education requirement.
Experienced in budget preparation and administration, and ability to implement budget requirements into departmental operations.
Knowledge of materials, techniques, equipment, personnel management, and best management practices associated with the science of developed and non-developed open space land management.
Ability to establish and maintain effective working relationships with elected officials, department heads, employees, and the general public.
Strong human relations leadership and communication skills.
Experienced in using computers and software application and applying technology to solve process problems. Experienced in using Word, Excel and Power Point software applications.
Possession of valid state driver’s license or Utah driving privilege card.

Desired Qualifications

Certified Park and Recreation Professional (CPRP)

About Salt Lake City Department Of Public Lands

We enhance the livability of the urban environment through a diverse network of natural open spaces, recreational opportunities, park facilities, city golf landscapes, the city cemetery and the urbanforest to ensure that the resources under our management are carefully stewarded for future generations.
